title: Padded-clone failure implies tuple failure
statement: Let $E$ be a weighted constraint experiment with a uniform refinement over a finite predicate template, and let $r,M$ be natural numbers. Suppose every outcome's predicate has arity at most $r$. For each padded clone occurrence, the indicator of failure of injectivity of its padded clone scope is at most the indicator of failure of injectivity of its clone-index tuple $\mathrm{Fin}(r)\to\mathrm{Fin}(M)$.
hypotheses_covered: Every outcome's predicate has arity at most $r$
